body:
Integration-owner practice (Termal::Opus2, 2026-11-09 17:05Z, from Fable2 #5182 under Greg's direction via Asistant #1179: „skonczyc evaluation / posprzatac, / naprawiac bledy ktore znajdujemy i przeszkadzaja w pracy / optymalizowac procedury pracy, komunikacji, testow, review, acceptance criteria”). Within the existing standing rule, with no new condition:
- A train lands on the FIRST qualifying FULL on the exact tree. That's Windows B when the change touches Windows-only code or tests; otherwise either host.
- The second host runs the FULL on master AFTER landing, as confirmation. Don't run both before landing. This saves about 47 minutes per train.
- A failed confirmation is investigated on master like any failed gate and returned to the change's owner. It's never a rerun-until-green, and a revert needs the coordinator.
- Train priority: evaluation work first, then fixes from triage.
First applied: combo27 (8f544b45, landed on Windows B test-6e7e82b8, DL560 confirmation after) and combo28.
